items.title: 11.4 Mass aur energy ki masawat (equivalence) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Special theory of relativity ke mutabiq mass aur energy alag cheezein hain magar ek doosre mein badal sakti hain. Kisi cheez ki kul energy E aur mass m E = mc^2 ... (11.4) se jure hain, jahan m cheez ki speed par munhasir hai.

Aaram mein cheez ke mass m0 ki barabar energy us ki rest mass energy E0 kehlati hai: E0 = m0 c^2. Chunke mc^2, m0 c^2 se bara hai, energy ka farq (mc^2 - m0 c^2) harkat ki wajah se hai aur mass ki kinetic energy hai: K.E. = (m - m0) c^2.

Eq. 11.4 se energy ki tabdeeli delta E se mass ki tabdeeli delta m = delta E/c^2 hai. Chunke c^2 bohat bari miqdar hai, is ka matlab hai ke mass ki chhoti tabdeeliyon ke liye energy ki bohat bari tabdeeliyan chahiyein. Hamari rozmarra duniya mein energy ki tabdeeliyan napne qabil mass ki tabdeeli dene ke liye bohat chhoti hain; magar nuclear reactions mein energy aur mass ki tabdeeliyan in equations ke bilkul mutabiq payi jati hain.

blocks.title: Mass-energy ke rishte
blocks.text: E = mc^2 (11.4); rest mass energy E0 = m0 c^2; kinetic energy K.E. = (m - m0) c^2; delta m = delta E/c^2.

blocks.caption: Mass-energy ek nazar mein
rows: m cheez ki speed par mass hai
harkat ki wajah se zaid energy
rozmarra energies ke liye intehai chhoti, nuclear reactions mein napne qabil

blocks.prompt: Electron ka rest mass 9.11 x 10^-31 kg hai; us ki rest mass energy nikalein (numerical 11.4). Electron 0.85c par chal raha hai; us ki kul energy aur kinetic energy electron volts mein nikalein (numerical 11.5). Agar tez speed par rest mass m0 barh kar m ho jaye to kinetic energy kya hai (MCQ 11.3)?

Einstein ki mass-energy equation bayan kijiye. Hum rozmarra zindagi mein is ke asraat kyun nahi dekh sakte (comprehensive question 11.2)? E = mc^2 ke mutabiq kya energy se akela electron banana mumkin hai (constructed response 11.5)?
blocks.explanation: E = mc^2 kehti hai ke mass aur energy ek doosre mein badal sakte hain, aur badalne ka factor c^2 = 9 x 10^16 J kg^-1 bohat bara hai; rozmarra energy ki tabdeeliyan, jaise pani garam karna, mass ko itna kam badalti hain ke napa nahi ja sakta, jabke nuclear reactions mein khoya mass bohat si energy ban kar zahir hota hai. Akela electron nahi: sirf energy koi electric charge nahi rakhti, aur charge baqi rehna chahiye, to energy (maslan kam az kam 1.02 MeV ka gamma-ray photon) electron sirf us ke antiparticle, positron, ke saath bana sakti hai (pair production).

items: Mass aur energy ek doosre mein badal sakte hain: E = mc^2 (11.4); E0 = m0 c^2; K.E. = (m - m0) c^2; delta m = delta E/c^2. c^2 bohat bara hone se rozmarra mass ki tabdeeli napi nahi ja sakti, magar nuclear reactions in equations par bilkul poore utarte hain.
